verdict.rationale: ROS 2 provides robust on-robot data capture via rosbag (record/play from CLI or Python API) and rich QoS policies for tuning network reliability, which support telemetry capture and resilient in-graph transport. However, there is no evidence of a built-in cloud-sync mechanism or bandwidth-aware upload policies for offloading bag data to cloud storage — that would typically require third-party tooling not documented here. Missing for 10: cloud sync/upload feature, bandwidth-aware scheduling for cloud transfer, evidence of integration with cloud storage services.
